title: lathyrus venosus subsp. arkansanus
intro: Lathyrus venosus subsp. arkansanus, commonly known as the Arkansas sweet pea, is a perennial legume that belongs to the Fabaceae family. It is used for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally employed to treat various health conditions. The plant is known to have several health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate respiratory issues, thanks to its therapeutic actions such as expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents present in Lathyrus venosus subsp. arkansanus include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
